title: Swarming Zombie updates to my survivors-like Driver Survivor
author: re-skob
selftext:
I asked Opus 5.5 to make a devlog video using the commit history from the commits around the swarming feature in my game Driver Survivor. I love the video that it made, and have rarely seen a dev log video go into such a crazy level of detail along with the design sensibility on how to visualize what the code is doing in an interesting way.

Check out the game on Steam [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5285800/Driver\_Survivor/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5285800/Driver_Survivor/)
